answer: GeoPin triangulates each seat from three probes and rejects any pair whose round trip vectors agree within a millisecond, since two honest machines never share one position. The penalty trigger is a coordinate contradiction: a seat whose measured vector drifts off its claimed location burns its forty POA bond and escrow. A hundred fakes need a hundred distinct residential endpoints at four dollars monthly, so the bill is four hundred dollars and every extra seat adds four, a cost no shared kernel or single river of traffic hides, while the bond stack rises like timber in a managed forest.
